verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's Signals docs mention a 'complete alerting solution' with 'multi-platform notifications' and direct notification of 'specific users and Slack channels,' implying some multi-channel delivery, but no evidence enumerates push, SMS, phone call, or email specifically, nor describes per-channel notification rule configuration. missing for 10: explicit documentation of SMS/phone/email/push channel options, per-channel rule configuration UI, and any hands-on confirmation of channel delivery.
